image_description: A medium shot of two men indoors. The man on the left is holding a black assault rifle (resembling an M4 or AR-15 platform) and aiming it towards the right. The man on the right is wearing a tactical vest and appears to be reacting to the weapon, possibly in a training scenario. The background is a plain wall.
